tacz_ammodata.config.title: Dede's Ammo System · Config
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.station.1: §7Right-click: refill all 7 ammo tables (§fcreative only§7, free)
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.station.2: §7Offhand holding a supply pack + right-click: fill the whole stack
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.station.3: §cLoose ammo is volatile — keep away from fire, lava, campfires and magma
msg.tacz_ammodata.emergency.nothing: Nothing to refill (not holding a TaCZ gun, or tables are full)
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.hazard: §cLoose ammo is volatile — keep away from any high-heat source
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.basic.1: §7You already carry a pouch, so handling ammo should be easier too:
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.basic.2: §7Gather the ingredients up front and crafting stays quick, simple and sturdy.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.basic.3: §7Built-in basic conversion module — limited points only.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.basic.4: §8Won't carry a full-scale war, but it's enough to clear the corner trash.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.advanced.1: §7Accepts rifles and shotguns too, and feeds material a good deal faster.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.advanced.2: §7Steel body with reinforced seams — survives a few knocks.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.advanced.3: §7Second-gen conversion module, with a roomier points budget.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.advanced.4: §8Something feels off... hey, why is there a note in here?
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.advanced.5: §8§m§9moli: What is this thing? Everything is flipped - so the rounds I pull out have the primer hitting the bullet?
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.advanced.6: §8§m§fdede: QAQ, how should I know about the render? Wait - the texture is completely transparent. Is this X-ray? Is that not great?
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.advanced.7: §8§m§9moli: Great your head. Selling ammo crates with free X-ray now?
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.elite.1: §7Nearly every ammo type converts here. Big body, looks right — practically an armory.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.elite.2: §7Fully expanded it holds about twenty basic crates — enough for a squad's hard fight.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.elite.3: §7Fully kitted conversion module — material goes in, usable ammo comes out.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.elite.4: §8Now it really can carry a full-scale war — just don't park it next to a fire.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.elite.5: §8§m§eshinai: 666 loose ammo, volatile as hell. One 20x expansion plus a torch and everything in reach turns to ash.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.elite.6: §8§m§fdede: Do not. Please do not. I finally got that crate filled - you cannot use it like that.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.elite.7: §8§m§eshinai: Relax, I have blown up dragon piles before. If I cannot blow this one up, I will eat it in front of you.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.ammo_bag.desc: §7Upgrades the ammo capacity of the gun in your offhand
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.ammo_bag.usage: §8Pouch in main hand · gun in offhand · right-click
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.ammo_bag.strict: §8No skipping: Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Netherite
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.detach.desc: §7A precision detaching tool built for tactical supply crates, forged from high-strength alloy.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.detach.usage: §7Safely releases the mechanical latch on a pouch, avoiding damage from brute force.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.detach.reusable: §8§fdede: There is a problem - this thing cannot work as a wrench. Nineteen issues out of ten. Something is off.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.material.desc: §7Pre-assembled ammo feedstock: one package, ready to seal into rounds
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.material.usage: §8Crate fuel slot to craft / right-click creative crate for points
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.crate.usage: §8Empty hand to open · sneak + right-click to pour all pending points
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.capacity: §7Right-click a crate: raises total capacity (one level at a time)
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.other: §7Right-click a crate: installs this upgrade line
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.warn: §8Upgrades only go up, and cannot be removed
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.iron.1: §7A ring of steel framing and riveted corner brackets — noticeably sturdier walls.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.iron.2: §8§fdede: Step one of the expansion - get the skeleton up first.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.gold.1: §7A gold-plated liner inside improves both conductivity and sealing.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.gold.2: §8§fdede: Money spent here feels safer than money spent on bullets.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.diamond.1: §7The whole cabinet is lined with diamond — wear, pressure and damp all handled.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.diamond.2: §8§fdede: Now that really is hard to smash.
§7The core is forged from netherite — the cabinet sits like bedrock.
§8§fdede: This is the ceiling. Going further means reshaping the block itself.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.efficiency: §7Batch after batch of material goes in, and more points come out.
§8§aranyu: So when are you finishing that enchanting table? I want Fortune - how long are we digging?
§8§fdede: Do not worry, we have 5x ore. Boric acid in one hand, ore washing in the other.
§8§aranyu: What an ugly machine. Could you at least route the cables cleanly?
§8§fdede: We have 5x ore this early - a gift. And you are nitpicking materials? If it works, it works.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.lucky.1: §7Batch runs occasionally yield a little more than they should.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.lucky.3: §8§fdede: Wait - you do know this thing is fully automatic, right? You carried all of it by hand?!!!
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.speed.1: §7A packaged, object-oriented upgrade class. Call it and polymorphism does the rest.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.speed.2: §7No reinventing wheels, no hand-forging. One call to upgrade().
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.speed.3: §7Pass in the base parameters; the template instantiates everything else.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.upgrade.speed.4: §8(If you're reading this error, you passed the template the wrong generics)
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.detach.more: §8§fdede: So how am I supposed to recover AE cables? Definitely adding that next update.
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.pack.usage: §8Right-click: fills what's missing along the hotbar
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.pack.refill: §8Right-click a crate: drains its pending points into this pack
tooltip.tacz_ammodata.pack.advanced_rule: §8Keeps an empty shell, but must be fully drained to refill
